the diagnosis is made by sonography and cystography, the treatment by conservative measures and the indication for operation is given by sonography.
in stage II renal trauma and in extraperitoneal bladder trauma the conservative treatment has to be preferred.
in case of severe renal trauma the kidney should be explored, in case of mild trauma conservative treatment should be preferred, in case of bladder rupture the patient should be operated immediately.
